subject: Helix Systems / Redwood marketplace demo — recording & host handback
messages:
From: Suresh Patel <suresh@helixsystems.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo ask — Helix x Redwood marketplace

Hi Sean / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick intro, Alex. We at Helix are excited to get a short technical walkthrough of Redwood’s inference platform and to discuss marketplace listing options. A few quick asks up front so we can confirm people: 

- Can Redwood record the demo for our internal replay? We sometimes share trimmed recordings on partner pages.
- If we agree to a marketplace recording, what are your retention and publishing policies? We need to confirm security/compliance internally.
- Who should be the host on Redwood’s side? We’ll have our Solutions Architect (me) + Product Manager (Rita) in the call.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed 4/22 10:00–10:45
- Thu 4/23 14:00–14:45

I attached a short Helix product overview for context.

Appreciate it —
Suresh
Suresh Patel
Head of Solutions, Helix Systems
--- attachment: Helix_tech_overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Suresh Patel <suresh@helixsystems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo ask — Helix x Redwood marketplace

Hi Suresh —

Thanks — those slots generally work. We can do Wed 4/22 at 10:00 PST. Quick responses to your asks: 

- Recording: Redwood records demos by default for internal review; we can also produce a trimmed copy for partner listing if Helix signs our marketplace consent.
- Retention/publishing: standard approach is to retain demo recordings for 90 days for internal QA; if you opt into marketplace listing we store a published copy per the marketplace listing terms (we'll send the consent form). If Helix requires a different retention window, flag it and we'll escalate.
- Host: I’ll host the call and hand back to Helix for Q/A. Vanessa will shadow the ops/runbook. We propose a short host-handback: Redwood runs first 30 minutes (walkthrough + demo), Helix takes the last 10–15 mins for partner-specific Q/A and to confirm any feature notes for the listing.

I attached our recording guidelines and the current demo runbook so you can see the handback points. Can you confirm attendees and whether Helix is OK with us listing a short clip (no PII) on the Redwood marketplace?

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm Wed 4/22 10:00 PST for 45 minutes
- Helix review + sign marketplace consent (DocuSign) before the demo if you want the clip published

Thanks — looking forward.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
--- attachments: redwood_marketplace_recording_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 120KB); demo_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Suresh Patel <suresh@helixsystems.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo ask — Helix x Redwood marketplace

Hi all — quick operational clarifications from Redwood ops: 

1) Consent and timing: If Helix wants a public/published marketplace clip, we need a signed consent form in DocuSign before the demo. I’ve attached our marketplace_consent_template for your legal/marketing to review. We’ll accept a signed PDF by noon PST the day before the demo.

2) Retention: Our standard internal retention window for recordings is 90 days. For partner-published copies we keep the published asset per the marketplace agreement; if Helix needs a specific retention (e.g., 180 days) we can document it in the marketplace opt-in and coordinate with legal.

3) Host handback: Operationally we ask for a 10–15 minute host handback at the end of the session where Helix leads the Q/A. To avoid confusion we’ll add a calendar note at +30m in the invite that changes the primary host role. Please confirm who will be co-hosting on Helix’s side so we can set the handback.

4) Recording storage: we’ll upload the final trimmed clip to a secured S3 bucket and share a Drive link with Helix. If you prefer us to send the raw recording instead, note that will include the full session and requires an approved intake form.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
--- attachment: marketplace_consent_template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Thanks Sean / Vanessa — that all sounds good. Confirming: Wed 4/22 10:00–10:45 PST works for Helix (me + Rita Kaur, PM). We are fine with Redwood recording for internal review and we approve a short clipped version for the Redwood marketplace — provided we get to sign the consent (I’ll have legal sign and return it).

We can agree to the 90-day internal retention but request the published clip be kept live for 180 days on your listing (Helix marketing would like a slightly longer live window). If this requires an exception, please flag and we’ll route via our legal.

Host co-ownership: Alex from AWS will be the technical co-host on our side. We agree to the 30/15 handback (Redwood runs first ~30, Helix closes out ~10–15).

I’ve attached the signed consent as a stub for now — legal will push the formal DocuSign shortly.

See you Wednesday.

—Suresh
